_comment: FROZEN human-review gold set (closures 1-6 + review-3/4). TWO-LEVEL truth: family_decision_truth (format/origin/bundle_content — needs human sign-off) + sku_offer_truth (price/availability/buy_url — AUTOMATIC from the Part-1 Ledger). accepted_skus are VARIANT-level SKU ids (defect #6). Origin requires description/structured evidence; name_token alone => unknown; inspiration => not a source. bundle_content is AUTHORED from descriptions with evidence (NOT regex — a repeated table-vs-file contradiction proved regex unsafe here); ambiguity/per-box => variant_specific. All Packages are set-valued bundles => out of single-format paths (ق4). expected is a SET: origin-fail (soft, ق9) => [HONEST_NO_MATCH, DISCLOSED_COMPROMISE]; format/budget-fail (hard/NEVER_RELAX) => [HONEST_NO_MATCH]. Do NOT regenerate intents from tree paths (closure #3). reviewed_by pending Ahmed Amer.
